connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — Sikkim State Electricity Regulatory Commission (SSERC), Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Table 9.2 'Tariff approved by the Commission for F.Y. 2025-26' (Commercial category): slabs 0-50/51-100/101-200/201-400/401+ units at 410/510/610/710/740 paise per unit; monthly minimum charge applies for sanctioned load below 25 KVA (1 Phase Rs 200, 3 Phase Rs 500 — used here). For sanctioned load 25 KVA and above, a per-KVA demand charge applies instead (Rural Rs 60/KVA/month, Urban Rs 100/KVA/month) — not modelled. https://selfservice.powersikkim.in/assets/home/Tariff-Schedule-FY-2025-26.pdf

PRIMARY — SSERC Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Table 9.2 (Industrial — LT Rural category): slabs up to 500 / 501-1000 / 1001+ units at 460/540/680 paise per unit; monthly minimum charge Rs 500/month for contract load 45 kW and below (used here) — for contract load above 45 kW, a demand charge of Rs 120/KVA/month applies instead (not modelled). LT Urban is a separate sub-category with higher rates (630/720/815 paise) and different fixed charges — not used here. https://selfservice.powersikkim.in/assets/home/Tariff-Schedule-FY-2025-26.pdf
